# Minchul Kim

> Minchul Kim is an Advanced Materials Engineer specializing in Metal Injection
> Molding (MIM) and Ceramic Injection Molding (CIM). This site is his professional
> portfolio: career history, technical projects, patents, publications, and
> contact information.

## Pages

- [Home](https://workshopcompany.github.io/minchul-kim/): Professional summary, experience, key projects, patents and publications, contact
- [CV (PDF)](https://workshopcompany.github.io/minchul-kim/CV(Minchul%20Kim)01222026.pdf): Curriculum vitae

## About

Advanced Materials Engineer specialized in Metal Injection Molding (MIM) and
Ceramic Injection Molding (CIM). Expert in formulating and scaling
high-solid-loading (45-67 vol%) feedstocks for complex, high-performance
components. Experience includes greenfield facility setup, yield improvement,
and regulatory clearance (IATF 16949, ISO 13485, FDA, CE), and development of
advanced materials including Titanium and pure Aluminum for EV/ADAS and medical
applications.

## Experience

- Plant General Manager, MIM Production Line — AUFlex Co., Ltd., Korea (Jul 2020 - Jun 2023)
- Medical Device Development Team Senior Engineer — Dentium / Genoss / Artificial Organ Research Center, Korea (Mar 2018 - Jul 2020)
- Mass Development Team Leader — Korea PIM Co., Ltd., Tier-1 supplier to Hyundai Motor Group (Nov 2013 - Mar 2018)
- R&D Team Leader, Precision Components — Ceratrac Co., Ltd., Korea (Apr 2011 - Nov 2013)

## Key Projects

- High-Density Pure Al MIM (99.5%): additive-free pure aluminum MIM process achieving >=97% relative density at industrial batch scales (20-160 kg)
- High-Density Ti-Fe MIM: cost-effective titanium MIM process achieving >=97% relative density without HIP using TiH2-Fe blends
- MOLDIQ and MIM-Ops Pro: free, cloud-native injection molding toolkit. MOLDIQ supports filling analysis, mold structure analysis, thermal and pressure distribution, defect prediction, dimensional prediction, and reverse design. MIM-Ops Pro delivers OpenFOAM flow simulation in the browser.
  - [MOLDIQ](https://moldiq-9rhzjfe6tmx8amj82ek2cw.streamlit.app/)
  - [MIM-Ops Pro](https://openfoam-injection-automation.streamlit.app/)
- MetalAtom: open-source gas atomizer simulator (EIGA) that finds process conditions for metal powder atomization, built from five years of hands-on EIGA experience
  - [MetalAtom on GitHub](https://github.com/workshopcompany/MetalAtom)

## Patents and Publications

- 5 Korean patents granted (2013-2016), including a high-loading MIM binder system and a binder composition for metal injection molding
- "Fabrication of anode support for solid oxide fuel cell using zirconium hydroxide as a pore former", Journal of Power Sources 195 (2010)
